title: A five-gene signature for hepatocellular carcinoma: analysis code
description:
Analysis code for the derivation and validation of a five-gene transcriptomic signature (CDKN2A, CCT6A, CSTB, ACLY, EPRS1) for hepatocellular carcinoma. The pipeline covers differential expression (limma), weighted gene co-expression network analysis, consensus ranking with ten algorithms applied singly and in all 45 pairwise combinations (55 rankings) under patient-grouped cross-validation, discrimination, calibration and decision curve analysis in three external cohorts, Cox modelling, consensus clustering, immune infiltration, cis-eQTL Mendelian randomisation and single-cell RNA sequencing analysis.

All input data are public: GSE14520, GSE76427, GSE62232, GSE149614, TCGA-LIHC, GTEx v8 and FinnGen R12. No data are redistributed in this repository.
